title: World model conditioned on the instrument (timsTOF vs Orbitrap/QTOF)
axis: instrument class (tims, orbitrap, qtof, trap, other) as a condition of the spectrum encoder (added to the precursor token) and of the forward world model (FiLM); code on branch e005-inst (d3a21ed); everything else as A0 (work/w4, --val work/cells, wm-canon recipe, 31k steps, seed 0)
question: Does telling the model which instrument measured a spectrum (and asking the world model to imagine each candidate on that instrument) improve ranking of natural products measured on timsTOF, the test instrument?
hypothesis: A1 beats A0 on np_tims (primary) without losing on np_c2.
declared_risk: every library timsTOF spectrum is Enveda-180 (drug-like screening chemistry); the timsTOF condition may carry a drug-like prior that hurts natural products. A2 (A1's weights, every query presented as orbitrap) measures it.

rules.leak_policy: every arm leak-free on every cell, else void
rules.consequence: inst_helps_tims and not tims_condition_harmful -> instrument-conditioned model becomes the bundle candidate (the pipeline's queries carry instrument_type); tims_condition_harmful -> deploy with the orbitrap condition or drop the axis
limitations: np_tims has 245 molecules (95% CI half-width ~0.03 on the fused metric)
